title: Great table napkins, great color!
text: Great table napkins, great color!. These are really nice table napkins for the money. Full size and absorbent, they work well for guests and family to use at meal time. The color (I received the grey) will blend with most decors and goes great in my dining room (mostly blue). Highly recommend this Whitewrap brand if you are in the market for new table napkins.
